shortDescription: Module for setup of ServiceEngineGroup Avi RESTful Object

options.name: accelerated_networking
options.description: Enable accelerated networking option for azure se. Accelerated networking enables single root i/o virtualization (sr-iov) to a se vm. This improves networking performance. Field introduced in 17.2.14,18.1.5,18.2.1.

options.name: active_standby
options.description: Service engines in active/standby mode for ha failover. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: additional_config_memory
options.description: Indicates the percent of config memory used for config updates. Allowed values are 0-90. Field deprecated in 18.1.2. Field introduced in 18.1.1.

options.name: advertise_backend_networks
options.description: Advertise reach-ability of backend server networks via adc through bgp for default gateway feature. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: aggressive_failure_detection
options.description: Enable aggressive failover configuration for ha. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: algo
options.description: In compact placement, virtual services are placed on existing ses until max_vs_per_se limit is reached. Enum options - PLACEMENT_ALGO_PACKED, PLACEMENT_ALGO_DISTRIBUTED. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as PLACEMENT_ALGO_PACKED.

options.name: allow_burst
options.description: Allow ses to be created using burst license. Field introduced in 17.2.5.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: app_cache_percent
options.description: A percent value of total se memory reserved for application caching. This is an se bootup property and requires se restart. Allowed values are 0 - 100. Special values are 0- 'disable'. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: app_learning_memory_percent
options.description: A percent value of total se memory reserved for application learning. This is an se bootup property and requires se restart. Allowed values are 0 - 10. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: archive_shm_limit
options.description: Amount of se memory in gb until which shared memory is collected in core archive. Field introduced in 17.1.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 8.

options.name: async_ssl
options.description: Ssl handshakes will be handled by dedicated ssl threads. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: async_ssl_threads
options.description: Number of async ssl threads per se_dp. Allowed values are 1-16. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: auto_rebalance
options.description: If set, virtual services will be automatically migrated when load on an se is less than minimum or more than maximum thresholds. Only alerts are generated when the auto_rebalance is not set. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: auto_rebalance_capacity_per_se
options.description: Capacities of se for auto rebalance for each criteria. Field introduced in 17.2.4.

options.name: auto_rebalance_criteria
options.description: Set of criteria for se auto rebalance. Enum options - SE_AUTO_REBALANCE_CPU, SE_AUTO_REBALANCE_PPS, SE_AUTO_REBALANCE_MBPS, SE_AUTO_REBALANCE_OPEN_CONNS, SE_AUTO_REBALANCE_CPS. Field introduced in 17.2.3.

options.name: auto_rebalance_interval
options.description: Frequency of rebalance, if 'auto rebalance' is enabled. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.

options.name: auto_redistribute_active_standby_load
options.description: Redistribution of virtual services from the takeover se to the replacement se can cause momentary traffic loss. If the auto-redistribute load option is left in its default off state, any desired rebalancing requires calls to rest api. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: bgp_state_update_interval
options.description: Bgp peer state update interval. Allowed values are 5-100. Field introduced in 17.2.14,18.1.5,18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 10.

options.name: buffer_se
options.description: Excess service engine capacity provisioned for ha failover. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: cloud_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type cloud.

options.name: config_debugs_on_all_cores
options.description: Enable config debugs on all cores of se. Field introduced in 17.2.13,18.1.5,18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: connection_memory_percentage
options.description: Percentage of memory for connection state. This will come at the expense of memory used for http in-memory cache. Allowed values are 10-90. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 50.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: cpu_reserve
options.description: Boolean flag to set cpu_reserve. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: cpu_socket_affinity
options.description: Allocate all the cpu cores for the service engine virtual machines  on the same cpu socket. Applicable only for vcenter cloud. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: custom_securitygroups_data
options.description: Custom security groups to be associated with data vnics for se instances in openstack and aws clouds. Field introduced in 17.1.3.

options.name: custom_securitygroups_mgmt
options.description: Custom security groups to be associated with management vnic for se instances in openstack and aws clouds. Field introduced in 17.1.3.

options.name: custom_tag
options.description: Custom tag will be used to create the tags for se instance in aws. Note this is not the same as the prefix for se name.

options.name: data_network_id
options.description: Subnet used to spin up the data nic for service engines, used only for azure cloud. Overrides the cloud level setting for service engine subnet. Field introduced in 18.2.3.

options.name: datascript_timeout
options.description: Number of instructions before datascript times out. Allowed values are 0-100000000. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1000000.

options.name: dedicated_dispatcher_core
options.description: Dedicate the core that handles packet receive/transmit from the network to just the dispatching function. Don't use it for tcp/ip and ssl functions. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: description
options.description: User defined description for the object.

options.name: disable_avi_securitygroups
options.description: By default, avi creates and manages security groups along with custom sg provided by user. Set this to true to disallow avi to create and manage new security groups. Avi will only make use of custom security groups provided by user. This option is only supported for aws cloud type. Field introduced in 17.2.13,18.1.4,18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: disable_csum_offloads
options.description: Stop using tcp/udp and ip checksum offload features of nics. Field introduced in 17.1.14, 17.2.5, 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: disable_gro
options.description: Disable generic receive offload (gro) in dpdk poll-mode driver packet receive path. Gro is on by default on nics that do not support lro (large receive offload) or do not gain performance boost from lro. Field introduced in 17.2.5, 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: disable_se_memory_check
options.description: If set, disable the config memory check done in service engine. Field introduced in 18.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: disable_tso
options.description: Disable tcp segmentation offload (tso) in dpdk poll-mode driver packet transmit path. Tso is on by default on nics that support it. Field introduced in 17.2.5, 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: disk_per_se
options.description: Amount of disk space for each of the service engine virtual machines. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 10.

options.name: distribute_load_active_standby
options.description: Use both the active and standby service engines for virtual service placement in the legacy active standby ha mode. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: distribute_queues
options.description: Distributes queue ownership among cores so multiple cores handle dispatcher duties. Field introduced in 17.2.8. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enable_hsm_priming
options.description: (this is a beta feature). Enable hsm key priming. If enabled, key handles on the hsm will be synced to se before processing client connections. Field introduced in 17.2.7, 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enable_multi_lb
options.description: Applicable only for azure cloud with basic sku lb. If set, additional azure lbs will be automatically created if resources in existing lb are exhausted. Field introduced in 17.2.10, 18.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enable_routing
options.description: Enable routing for this serviceenginegroup . Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enable_vip_on_all_interfaces
options.description: Enable vip on all interfaces of se. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: enable_vmac
options.description: Use virtual mac address for interfaces on which floating interface ips are placed. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: ephemeral_portrange_end
options.description: End local ephemeral port number for outbound connections. Field introduced in 17.2.13, 18.1.5, 18.2.1.

options.name: ephemeral_portrange_start
options.description: Start local ephemeral port number for outbound connections. Field introduced in 17.2.13, 18.1.5, 18.2.1.

options.name: extra_config_multiplier
options.description: Multiplier for extra config to support large vs/pool config. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.0.

options.name: extra_shared_config_memory
options.description: Extra config memory to support large geo db configuration. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: floating_intf_ip
options.description: If serviceenginegroup is configured for legacy 1+1 active standby ha mode, floating ip's will be advertised only by the active se in the pair. Virtual services in this group must be disabled/enabled for any changes to the floating ip's to take effect. Only active se hosting vs tagged with active standby se 1 tag will advertise this floating ip when manual load distribution is enabled.

options.name: floating_intf_ip_se_2
options.description: If serviceenginegroup is configured for legacy 1+1 active standby ha mode, floating ip's will be advertised only by the active se in the pair. Virtual services in this group must be disabled/enabled for any changes to the floating ip's to take effect. Only active se hosting vs tagged with active standby se 2 tag will advertise this floating ip when manual load distribution is enabled.

options.name: flow_table_new_syn_max_entries
options.displayName: Flow Table New Syn Max Entries
options.description: Maximum number of flow table entries that have not completed tcp three-way handshake yet. Field introduced in 17.2.5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: free_list_size
options.description: Number of entries in the free list. Field introduced in 17.2.10, 18.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1024.

options.name: ha_mode
options.description: High availability mode for all the virtual services using this service engine group. Enum options - HA_MODE_SHARED_PAIR, HA_MODE_SHARED, HA_MODE_LEGACY_ACTIVE_STANDBY. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as HA_MODE_SHARED.

options.name: hardwaresecuritymodulegroup_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type hardwaresecuritymodulegroup.

options.name: heap_minimum_config_memory
options.description: Minimum required heap memory to apply any configuration. Allowed values are 0-100. Field introduced in 18.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 8.

options.name: hm_on_standby
options.description: Enable active health monitoring from the standby se for all placed virtual services. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: host_attribute_key
options.description: Key of a (key, value) pair identifying a label for a set of nodes usually in container clouds. Needs to be specified together with host_attribute_value. Ses can be configured differently including ha modes across different se groups. May also be used for isolation between different classes of virtualservices. Virtualservices' se group may be specified via annotations/labels. A openshift/kubernetes namespace maybe annotated with a matching se group label as openshift.io/node-selector  apptype=pro

options.name: host_attribute_value
options.description: Value of a (key, value) pair identifying a label for a set of nodes usually in container clouds. Needs to be specified together with host_attribute_key.

options.name: host_gateway_monitor
options.description: Enable the host gateway monitor when service engine is deployed as docker container. Disabled by default. Field introduced in 17.2.4. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: hypervisor
options.description: Override default hypervisor. Enum options - DEFAULT, VMWARE_ESX, KVM, VMWARE_VSAN, XEN.

options.name: ignore_rtt_threshold
options.description: Ignore rtt samples if it is above threshold. Field introduced in 17.1.6,17.2.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 5000.

options.name: ingress_access_data
options.description: Program se security group ingress rules to allow vip data access from remote cidr type. Enum options - SG_INGRESS_ACCESS_NONE, SG_INGRESS_ACCESS_ALL, SG_INGRESS_ACCESS_VPC. Field introduced in 17.1.5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as SG_INGRESS_ACCESS_ALL.

options.name: ingress_access_mgmt
options.description: Program se security group ingress rules to allow ssh/icmp management access from remote cidr type. Enum options - SG_INGRESS_ACCESS_NONE, SG_INGRESS_ACCESS_ALL, SG_INGRESS_ACCESS_VPC. Field introduced in 17.1.5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as SG_INGRESS_ACCESS_ALL.

options.name: instance_flavor
options.description: Instance/flavor name for se instance.

options.name: iptables
options.description: Iptables rules.

options.name: least_load_core_selection
options.description: Select core with least load for new flow. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: license_tier
options.description: Specifies the license tier which would be used. This field by default inherits the value from cloud. Enum options - ENTERPRISE_16, ENTERPRISE_18. Field introduced in 17.2.5.

options.name: license_type
options.description: If no license type is specified then default license enforcement for the cloud type is chosen. Enum options - LIC_BACKEND_SERVERS, LIC_SOCKETS, LIC_CORES, LIC_HOSTS, LIC_SE_BANDWIDTH, LIC_METERED_SE_BANDWIDTH. Field introduced in 17.2.5.

options.name: log_disksz
options.description: Maximum disk capacity (in mb) to be allocated to an se. This is exclusively used for debug and log data. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 10000.

options.name: max_cpu_usage
options.description: When cpu usage on an se exceeds this threshold, virtual services hosted on this se may be rebalanced to other ses to reduce load. A new se may be created as part of this process. Allowed values are 40-90. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 80.

options.name: max_memory_per_mempool
options.description: Max bytes that can be allocated in a single mempool. Field introduced in 18.1.5. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 64.

options.name: max_public_ips_per_lb
options.description: Applicable to azure platform only. Maximum number of public ips per azure lb. Field introduced in 17.2.12, 18.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 30.

options.name: max_rules_per_lb
options.description: Applicable to azure platform only. Maximum number of rules per azure lb. Field introduced in 17.2.12, 18.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 150.

options.name: max_scaleout_per_vs
options.description: Maximum number of active service engines for the virtual service. Allowed values are 1-64. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.

options.name: max_se
options.description: Maximum number of services engines in this group. Allowed values are 0-1000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 10.

options.name: max_vs_per_se
options.description: Maximum number of virtual services that can be placed on a single service engine. East west virtual services are excluded from this limit. Allowed values are 1-1000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 10.

options.name: mem_reserve
options.description: Boolean flag to set mem_reserve. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: memory_for_config_update
options.description: Indicates the percent of memory reserved for config updates. Allowed values are 0-100. Field introduced in 18.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 15.

options.name: memory_per_se
options.description: Amount of memory for each of the service engine virtual machines. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 2048.

options.name: mgmt_network_ref
options.description: Management network to use for avi service engines. It is a reference to an object of type network.

options.name: mgmt_subnet
options.description: Management subnet to use for avi service engines.

options.name: min_cpu_usage
options.description: When cpu usage on an se falls below the minimum threshold, virtual services hosted on the se may be consolidated onto other underutilized ses. After consolidation, unused service engines may then be eligible for deletion. Allowed values are 20-60. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 30.

options.name: min_scaleout_per_vs
options.description: Minimum number of active service engines for the virtual service. Allowed values are 1-64. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: min_se
options.description: Minimum number of services engines in this group (relevant for se autorebalance only). Allowed values are 0-1000. Field introduced in 17.2.13,18.1.3,18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: minimum_connection_memory
options.description: Indicates the percent of memory reserved for connections. Allowed values are 0-100. Field introduced in 18.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 20.

options.name: minimum_required_config_memory
options.description: Required available config memory to apply any configuration. Allowed values are 0-90. Field deprecated in 18.1.2. Field introduced in 18.1.1.

options.name: n_log_streaming_threads
options.description: Number of threads to use for log streaming. Allowed values are 1-100. Field introduced in 17.2.12, 18.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the object.

options.name: non_significant_log_throttle
options.description: This setting limits the number of non-significant logs generated per second per core on this se. Default is 100 logs per second. Set it to zero (0) to disable throttling. Field introduced in 17.1.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 100.

options.name: num_dispatcher_cores
options.description: Number of dispatcher cores (0,1,2,4,8 or 16). If set to 0, then number of dispatcher cores is deduced automatically. Allowed values are 0,1,2,4,8,16. Field introduced in 17.2.12, 18.1.3, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: num_flow_cores_sum_changes_to_ignore
options.displayName: Num Flow Cores Sum Changes To Ignore
options.description: Number of changes in num flow cores sum to ignore. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 8.

options.name: openstack_availability_zone
options.description: Field deprecated in 17.1.1.

options.name: openstack_availability_zones
options.description: Field introduced in 17.1.1.

options.name: openstack_mgmt_network_name
options.description: Avi management network name.

options.name: openstack_mgmt_network_uuid
options.description: Management network uuid.

options.name: os_reserved_memory
options.description: Amount of extra memory to be reserved for use by the operating system on a service engine. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: per_app
options.description: Per-app se mode is designed for deploying dedicated load balancers per app (vs). In this mode, each se is limited to a max of 2 vss. Vcpus in per-app ses count towards licensing usage at 25% rate. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: placement_mode
options.description: If placement mode is 'auto', virtual services are automatically placed on service engines. Enum options - PLACEMENT_MODE_AUTO. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as PLACEMENT_MODE_AUTO.

options.name: realtime_se_metrics
options.description: Enable or disable real time se metrics.

options.name: reboot_on_stop
options.description: Reboot the system if the se is stopped. Field introduced in 17.2.16,18.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: se_bandwidth_type
options.description: Select the se bandwidth for the bandwidth license. Enum options - SE_BANDWIDTH_UNLIMITED, SE_BANDWIDTH_25M, SE_BANDWIDTH_200M, SE_BANDWIDTH_1000M, SE_BANDWIDTH_10000M. Field introduced in 17.2.5.

options.name: se_deprovision_delay
options.description: Duration to preserve unused service engine virtual machines before deleting them. If traffic to a virtual service were to spike up abruptly, this se would still be available to be utilized again rather than creating a new se. If this value is set to 0, controller will never delete any ses and administrator has to manually cleanup unused ses. Allowed values are 0-525600. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 120.

options.name: se_dos_profile
options.description: Dosthresholdprofile settings for serviceenginegroup.

options.name: se_dpdk_pmd
options.description: Determines if dpdk pool mode driver should be used or not   0  automatically determine based on hypervisor/nic type 1  unconditionally use dpdk poll mode driver 2  don't use dpdk poll mode driver. Allowed values are 0-2. Field introduced in 18.1.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: se_flow_probe_retries
options.description: Flow probe retry count if no replies are received. Allowed values are 0-5. Field introduced in 18.1.4, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 2.

options.name: se_flow_probe_timer
options.description: Timeout in milliseconds for flow probe entries. Allowed values are 10-200. Field introduced in 18.1.4, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 100.

options.name: se_ipc_udp_port
options.description: Udp port for se_dp ipc in docker bridge mode. Field introduced in 17.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1500.

options.name: se_name_prefix
options.description: Prefix to use for virtual machine name of service engines. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as Avi.

options.name: se_pcap_lookahead
options.description: Enables lookahead mode of packet receive in pcap mode. Introduced to overcome an issue with hv_netvsc driver. Lookahead mode attempts to ensure that application and kernel's view of the receive rings are consistent. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: se_pcap_reinit_frequency
options.description: Frequency in seconds at which periodically a pcap reinit check is triggered. May be used in conjunction with the configuration pcap_reinit_threshold. (valid range   15 mins - 12 hours, 0 - disables). Allowed values are 900-43200. Special values are 0- 'disable'. Field introduced in 17.2.13, 18.1.3, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: se_pcap_reinit_threshold
options.description: Threshold for input packet receive errors in pcap mode exceeding which a pcap reinit is triggered. If not set, an unconditional reinit is performed. This value is checked every pcap_reinit_frequency interval. Field introduced in 17.2.13, 18.1.3, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: se_probe_port
options.description: Tcp port on se where echo service will be run. Field introduced in 17.2.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 7.

options.name: se_remote_punt_udp_port
options.description: Udp port for punted packets in docker bridge mode. Field introduced in 17.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1501.

options.name: se_routing
options.description: Enable routing via service engine datapath. When disabled, routing is done by the linux kernel. Ip routing needs to be enabled in service engine group for se routing to be effective. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: se_sb_dedicated_core
options.description: Sideband traffic will be handled by a dedicated core. Field introduced in 16.5.2, 17.1.9, 17.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: se_sb_threads
options.description: Number of sideband threads per se. Allowed values are 1-128. Field introduced in 16.5.2, 17.1.9, 17.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: se_thread_multiplier
options.description: Multiplier for se threads based on vcpu. Allowed values are 1-10. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: se_tracert_port_range
options.description: Traceroute port range. Field introduced in 17.2.8.

options.name: se_tunnel_mode
options.description: Determines if dsr from secondary se is active or not  0  automatically determine based on hypervisor type. 1  disable dsr unconditionally. 2  enable dsr unconditionally. Allowed values are 0-2. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: se_tunnel_udp_port
options.description: Udp port for tunneled packets from secondary to primary se in docker bridge mode. Field introduced in 17.1.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1550.

options.name: se_udp_encap_ipc
options.description: Determines if se-se ipc messages are encapsulated in a udp header  0  automatically determine based on hypervisor type. 1  use udp encap unconditionally. Allowed values are 0-1. Field introduced in 17.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: se_use_dpdk
options.description: Determines if dpdk library should be used or not   0  automatically determine based on hypervisor type 1  use dpdk if pcap is not enabled 2 don't use dpdk. Allowed values are 0-2. Field introduced in 18.1.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: se_vs_hb_max_pkts_in_batch
options.displayName: Se Vs Hb Max Pkts In Batch
options.description: Maximum number of aggregated vs heartbeat packets to send in a batch. Allowed values are 1-256. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 64.

options.name: se_vs_hb_max_vs_in_pkt
options.displayName: Se Vs Hb Max Vs In Pkt
options.description: Maximum number of virtualservices for which heartbeat messages are aggregated in one packet. Allowed values are 1-1024. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 256.

options.name: self_se_election
options.description: Enable ses to elect a primary amongst themselves in the absence of a connectivity to controller. Field introduced in 18.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: service_ip6_subnets
options.description: Ipv6 subnets assigned to the se group. Required for vs group placement. Field introduced in 18.1.1.

options.name: service_ip_subnets
options.description: Subnets assigned to the se group. Required for vs group placement. Field introduced in 17.1.1.

options.name: shm_minimum_config_memory
options.description: Minimum required shared memory to apply any configuration. Allowed values are 0-100. Field introduced in 18.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.

options.name: significant_log_throttle
options.description: This setting limits the number of significant logs generated per second per core on this se. Default is 100 logs per second. Set it to zero (0) to disable throttling. Field introduced in 17.1.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 100.

options.name: ssl_preprocess_sni_hostname
options.description: (beta) preprocess ssl client hello for sni hostname extension.if set to true, this will apply sni child's ssl protocol(s), if they are different from sni parent's allowed ssl protocol(s). Field introduced in 17.2.12, 18.1.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: udf_log_throttle
options.description: This setting limits the number of udf logs generated per second per core on this se. Udf logs are generated due to the configured client log filters or the rules with logging enabled. Default is 100 logs per second. Set it to zero (0) to disable throttling. Field introduced in 17.1.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 100.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: use_standard_alb
options.description: Use standard sku azure load balancer. By default cloud level flag is set. If not set, it inherits/uses the use_standard_alb flag from the cloud. Field introduced in 18.2.3.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Unique object identifier of the object.

options.name: vcenter_clusters
options.description: Vcenterclusters settings for serviceenginegroup.

options.name: vcenter_datastore_mode
options.description: Enum options - vcenter_datastore_any, vcenter_datastore_local, vcenter_datastore_shared. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as VCENTER_DATASTORE_ANY.

options.name: vcenter_datastores
options.description: List of vcenterdatastore.

options.name: vcenter_datastores_include
options.description: Boolean flag to set vcenter_datastores_include. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: vcenter_folder
options.description: Folder to place all the service engine virtual machines in vcenter. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as AviSeFolder.

options.name: vcenter_hosts
options.description: Vcenterhosts settings for serviceenginegroup.

options.name: vcpus_per_se
options.description: Number of vcpus for each of the service engine virtual machines. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: vip_asg
options.description: When vip_asg is set, vip configuration will be managed by avi.user will be able to configure vip_asg or vips individually at the time of create. Field introduced in 17.2.12, 18.1.2.

options.name: vs_host_redundancy
options.description: Ensure primary and secondary service engines are deployed on different physical hosts. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: vs_scalein_timeout
options.description: Time to wait for the scaled in se to drain existing flows before marking the scalein done. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 30.

options.name: vs_scalein_timeout_for_upgrade
options.description: During se upgrade, time to wait for the scaled-in se to drain existing flows before marking the scalein done. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 30.

options.name: vs_scaleout_timeout
options.description: Time to wait for the scaled out se to become ready before marking the scaleout done. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 600.

options.name: vs_se_scaleout_additional_wait_time
options.displayName: Vs Se Scaleout Additional Wait Time
options.description: Wait time for sending scaleout ready notification after virtual service is marked up. In certain deployments, there may be an additional delay to accept traffic. For example, for bgp, some time is needed for route advertisement. Allowed values are 0-20. Field introduced in 18.1.5,18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: vs_se_scaleout_ready_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for service engine to sendscaleout ready notification of a virtual service. Allowed values are 0-60. Field introduced in 18.1.5,18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 25.

options.name: vs_switchover_timeout
options.description: During se upgrade in a legacy active/standby segroup, time to wait for the new primary se to accept flows before marking the switchover done. Field introduced in 17.2.13,18.1.4,18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.

options.name: vss_placement
options.description: Parameters to place virtual services on only a subset of the cores of an se. Field introduced in 17.2.5.

options.name: vss_placement_enabled
options.description: If set, virtual services will be placed on only a subset of the cores of an se. Field introduced in 18.1.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: waf_learning_interval
options.description: Frequency with which se publishes waf learning. Allowed values are 1-43200. Field deprecated in 18.2.3. Field introduced in 18.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 10.

options.name: waf_learning_memory
options.description: Amount of memory reserved on se for waf learning. Cannot exceed 5% of se memory. Field deprecated in 18.2.3. Field introduced in 18.1.2. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: waf_mempool
options.description: Enable memory pool for waf. Field introduced in 17.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: waf_mempool_size
options.description: Memory pool size used for waf. Field introduced in 17.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 64.
